about: Mods for Claude Code made by other people, listed and checked by modmyclaude. Criteria and what "checked" means: COMMUNITY.md in this repo.

mods.name: context-bar
mods.title: Context Bar
mods.summary: One bar above the prompt, split by what fills the context window.
mods.author: hamzafer
mods.says: One bar split by what fills the window; reads the cache lifetime from the session transcript (docs/mods.md).

passed: no undeclared network or model calls
pending: installs on the current Claude Code, terminal and desktop

mods.name: image-view
mods.title: Image View
mods.summary: Thumbnails of pasted images above the prompt, made on your machine.
mods.author: jarrodwatts
mods.says: Local only, no network; reads the prompt box and Claude Code's temp image cache; runs sips for non-PNG pastes and writes one PNG thumbnail (README, Security).

passed: no undeclared network or model calls

mods.name: filetree
mods.title: Filetree
mods.summary: An IDE-style file tree pane with git status, Quick Look and open-in-editor.
mods.author: data-goblin
mods.says: git status and git or gh operations, Quick Look on macOS, open with the default app or your editor in tmux or herdr (README).

writes and removes temp marker files
sees every tool call and prompt

mods.name: hal-grammar-check

mods.summary: A grammar check of your prompt as you type, through Claude Haiku on your own account or a local Ollama.

mods.name: prayer-times
mods.title: Prayer Times
mods.summary: Prayer times for the coordinates you set, computed on your computer.
mods.author: hamzafer
mods.says: Latitude and longitude stay in your local settings; times are computed on your computer from the sun's position, so nothing is sent anywhere (docs/mods.md).
reach: reads env and files (the band order file)
mods.notes: One test assumes a London clock and fails in other time zones; the mod itself is fine.

mods.name: open-paths
mods.title: Open Paths
mods.summary: Clickable file paths in replies that open in your editor or default app.
mods.author: kiankhooban
mods.says: Sends nothing; reads file metadata only; stores settings and up to 500 paths; runs only the named openers and editors, on a click (README, What it reads, runs and sends; PRIVACY.md).
reach: runs programs (uname, open or xdg-open, your editor) on a click
sees Read, Write and Edit tool calls
mods.notes: Opening an .html or .svg runs its scripts in your browser, as the README warns.

mods.name: mdview
mods.title: Mdview
mods.summary: Renders Markdown files named in the conversation in a pane, with an edit bar.
mods.author: xuanji86
mods.says: Reads files named in the conversation; runs sips and open on your click; sends a prompt only when you press Enter in its edit bar; changes its own setting with /md mode; no network, no model, nothing stored across sessions (README, What it can reach).

submits a prompt when you press Enter in its edit bar

mods.name: now-playing
mods.title: Now Playing
mods.summary: What Spotify is playing, in a band, with lyrics from LRCLIB that you can switch off. macOS only.
mods.author: hamzafer
mods.says: macOS and Spotify only, read through AppleScript; checks Spotify every 3 to 5 seconds; track, artist and album names go to LRCLIB once per track; lyrics off sends nothing (docs/mods.md, Privacy).

mods.name: gfm-render
mods.title: GFM Render
mods.summary: GitHub-flavoured Markdown in replies: alerts, task lists and diagrams.
mods.author: briangtn
mods.says: A SessionStart hook adds a short formatting note to Claude's context at startup, after /clear and after compaction; promptHint false turns it off; diagrams on the desktop run node once per diagram, then cached (README).
reach: adds a short formatting note to Claude's context at startup (switchable off)
runs node for diagrams on the desktop
mods.notes: Vendors beautiful-mermaid and elkjs (EPL-2.0) with their licence files.

mods.name: glance
mods.title: Glance
mods.summary: A band of what needs you across GitHub, Google Calendar, Linear and Slack, refreshed every 5 minutes.
